key.name: fade-duration
key.description: How long the trail takes to fade out in milliseconds

key.name: line-width
key.description: Thickness of the mouse trail line

key.name: color
key.description: Color of the mouse trail as RGB values (legacy flat key, migrated into the default profile)

key.name: alpha
key.description: Transparency level of the mouse trail (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque)

key.name: render-mode
key.description: Rendering mode for the mouse trail: "precise" for segmented smooth curves, "balance" for unified smooth curves, or "fast" for simple lines

key.name: color-mode
key.description: Color mode for the mouse trail: "solid" for single color with fade, "rainbow-fixed" for fixed-length rainbow gradient, "rainbow-ratio" for ratio-based rainbow gradient, or "rainbow-time" for time-based cycling rainbow

key.name: rainbow-fixed-config
key.description: Configuration for fixed-length rainbow mode. Each line: #RRGGBB distance(px). The last color does not need a distance.

key.name: rainbow-ratio-config
key.description: Configuration for ratio rainbow mode. Each line: #RRGGBB ratio(positive number). Values are normalized automatically.

key.name: rainbow-time-config
key.description: Configuration for time-based rainbow mode. Each line: #RRGGBB time(ms). All colors must have a time.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of profiles. Each profile: {id, name, conditions{color-scheme,workspaces,time,wm-class}, settings{...}}. Specificity = number of set conditions; higher wins, ties broken by later list position. Unset settings fall through to lower-priority profiles, ending at factory defaults. The first profile (id "default") has no conditions and cannot be removed.

key.name: active-profile
key.description: Written by the extension on every recompute: JSON {winner, effective} describing the currently applied profile name and effective settings. Read by the preferences dialog for status display and preview.

key.name: profile-system-version
key.description: Migration marker for the profile-based settings system. 0 = legacy flat keys not yet migrated.

key.name: seen-wm-classes
key.description: JSON array of wm_class values observed by the extension, used to offer suggestions in the preferences dialog.
